phase_prompt.summary: Gentle breeze across the meadow, wind as crystalline glyphs.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic, photorealistic vertical 9:16 timelapse of a solitary ancient oak tree in a meadow, with wind rendered as a translucent veil of crystalline glyphs and luminescent dust. The grass ripples in soft motion blur while the oak remains still, under a sky of moving clouds, evoking ancient mysticism and advanced technology.
